newsitem.title: USA: Paragon says mulling strategic options.
newsitem.headline: Paragon says mulling strategic options.

text.p: Paragon Group Inc said on Tuesday it had hired Merrill Lynch & Co to assist it in evaluating potential strategic alternatives to enhance shareholder value.

These include a potential strategic merger transaction with a limited number of potential partners, direct institutional investment, public and private sources of debt and equity capital, and continuing strategic actions with its existing multi-family portfolio, the company said.
